subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: What retention and replay contract should OpenClaw use for same-route Gemini visible textSignature values on visible text blocks?
rationale: Current code and tests intentionally preserve valid same-route visible textSignature values, while this issue shows those values can grow session history until provider runs abort and channel replies are lost; changing the contract safely needs provider ownership.

options.title: Bound visible-text signatures
options.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but cap, drop, or externalize visible textSignature values before persisted replay.

options.title: Keep current replay
options.body: Accept the remaining session-bloat risk in exchange for preserving every valid same-route Gemini signature exactly as stored.

options.title: Split a design item
options.body: Design the Google signature-retention contract in a narrower maintainer-owned item before implementation starts.

recommendation.title: Bound visible-text signatures
recommendation.body: Preserve required tool-call/native-thinking signatures but cap, drop, or externalize visible textSignature values before persisted replay.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior native-Google signature-bloat fix and the direct-Gemini native reasoning fix, making him the strongest routing owner for the replay-contract choice.
